name: IC Isolator — 80V — DIP
description: DIP IC isolator cluster featuring 80V rating with through-hole DIP-4 footprints in 7.62mm and 10.16mm widths.
selection_hints: Select DIP-4_W7.62mm or DIP-4_W10.16mm footprint based on required lead spacing width.
Choose between tier A parts TLP785 and TLP785F.
Use when a through-hole 80V IC isolator is required.
avoid_when: Avoid when surface-mount components are required instead of through-hole DIP.
Do not use if footprints other than DIP-4 W7.62mm or W10.16mm are required.
Avoid when component types other than 80V IC isolators are needed.
